title: Birbal and the Foolish Thief
moral: Everyone deserves a chance to change and do better.

scenes.summary: A thief is caught after stealing from a house.
scenes.text: One night, a thief stole valuables from a rich man’s house but was caught by guards and brought to Emperor Akbar.
scenes.image_prompt: guards catching thief at night outside house, cartoon style

scenes.summary: The thief explains his actions to Akbar.
scenes.text: The thief told Akbar he stole because he was poor and needed money. Akbar was unsure what to do.
scenes.image_prompt: thief explaining to king in court, emotional cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Birbal decides to test the thief’s honesty.
scenes.text: Birbal stepped forward and gave the thief a gold coin, asking him to return it the next day.
scenes.image_prompt: birbal giving gold coin to thief in court, cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: The thief returns the coin honestly.
scenes.text: The next day, the thief returned the coin just as Birbal had asked.
scenes.image_prompt: thief returning coin honestly to birbal, warm cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Akbar gives the thief a second chance.
scenes.text: Birbal explained that the thief could be honest. Akbar gave him a chance to change. Everyone deserves a chance to do better.
scenes.image_prompt: king forgiving thief while birbal smiles, positive cartoon

story: One night, a thief stole valuables from a rich man’s house but was caught and brought to Emperor Akbar. The thief said he stole because he was poor. Birbal tested him by giving him a gold coin to return the next day. The thief returned the coin honestly. Birbal showed that he could change, and Akbar gave him a second chance.
